# claimed media type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:claimedMediaType`](gmeow-claimedMediaType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/claimedMediaType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The MIME media type CLAIMED by a filename's extension (e.g. ".pdf" → "application/pdf"). A claim by the name, which may disagree with [`gmeow:detectedMediaType`](gmeow-detectedMediaType.md). Non-functional.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Filename`](../classes/gmeow-Filename.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:claimedMediaType`](gmeow-claimedMediaType.md) from [`gmeow:Filename`](../classes/gmeow-Filename.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Filename`](../classes/gmeow-Filename.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the MIME media type a [`gmeow:Filename`](../classes/gmeow-Filename.md)'s extension CLAIMS — the type asserted by the name, to be compared against the type detected from the bytes.

### Avoid when

- Avoid treating the claim as the truth (the bytes' [`gmeow:detectedMediaType`](gmeow-detectedMediaType.md) may disagree) and avoid resolving a mismatch into a contradiction — both coexist as confidence-weighted claims.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:claimedMediaType`](gmeow-claimedMediaType.md) on a [`Filename`](../classes/gmeow-Filename.md) from its extension; pair with [`gmeow:detectedMediaType`](gmeow-detectedMediaType.md) and let a disagreement coexist rather than asserting disjointness.

### Examples

- ex:report [`gmeow:claimedMediaType`](gmeow-claimedMediaType.md) "application/pdf".
